name: Billie Gadsdon
bio: Billie Gadsdon was born on 1 November 2012 in the United Kingdom. She is an actress, known for Tales of Babylon (2023), Cruella (2021) and Here (2024).

credits.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
credits.overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

credits.title: Liv
credits.overview: When her mother leaves unexpectedly, Liv uses magical thinking to try and regain control of her world.

credits.title: Here
credits.overview: An odyssey through time and memory, centered on a place in New Jersey where—from wilderness, and then, later, from a home—love, loss, struggle, hope and legacy play out between couples and families over generations.

credits.title: Tales of Babylon
credits.overview: Two siblings, looking to escape their abusive mobster grandfather, join forces with a pair of hitmen with a knack for the theatrical in their search for a new life in this tale of crime, violence, and redemption.

credits.title: Nocebo
credits.overview: A fashion designer suffers from a mysterious illness that puzzles her doctors and frustrates her husband until help arrives in the form of a Filipino caregiver who uses traditional folk healing to reveal a horrifying truth.

credits.title: Cruella
credits.overview: In 1970s London amidst the punk rock revolution, a young grifter named Estella is determined to make a name for herself with her designs.
